name: preview-route-runtime
goal: Managed preview keeps server and client route indexes aligned after normal SvelteKit sync.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Pages must hydrate Pages after normal SvelteKit sync while the managed preview remains running. Bun and Node manifest inventories produce different node order.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing preview lifecycle fixtures use plain Vite HTML, so they never compared real SvelteKit server node IDs against client modules after external sync. Extended that same lifecycle test.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test 14e16604 fails with real hydration mismatch: red record 77e73281. The valid fixture adds routes in authoring order, then runs the normal sync command.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fix 3ccd1e8b launches managed Vite with Node, matching normal SvelteKit sync without changing the regression corpus.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Formal green 57c0f081 at 3ccd1e8b passes the unchanged red command and tests from 14e16604; all eight preview lifecycle checks also pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
